brief: Violet seismic waves pulse across a dark grey canvas like underground energy surfacing. Thick jagged lines fracture horizontally, shifting speed and opacity based on horizontal mouse position, while vertical cracks bloom randomly without user input. Occasional bright white bolts shoot upward from the bottom edge when the cursor releases a drag. The entire field vibrates slightly on its own, simulating constant tectonic pressure before human interaction intensifies specific fractures or triggers new fault lines across the display.

Thick horizontal cracks fracture across the canvas at varying speeds and opacities, responding dynamically to user drag gestures.
